method: Manual reading of DigitalOcean's public Signup Credit documentation and Promotional Credit & Discount Terms; no account or checkout test.

sections.excerpt: When you create your first team, DigitalOcean automatically applies a $5 signup credit. No promo code is required.
sections.observation: First-team signup credit is automatic and does not require a code.

sections.excerpt: Signup credits expire 90 days after signup.
sections.observation: The published signup-credit expiry is 90 days after signup.
The page lists the eligible product scope and excludes SaaS Add-Ons.

sections.excerpt: You must add a valid payment method before you can create Droplets or other resources.
sections.observation: A valid payment method is required before creating resources.

sections.excerpt: Each Promotional Credit or Discount code can only be redeemed once and only on one DigitalOcean account.
sections.observation: An issued promotional code is single-use on one account; this does not publish a general code.

sections.excerpt: Promotional Credits and Discounts may not be used in conjunction with any other promotional or incentive offer
will not be applied against any sales, use, gross receipts, or similar transaction based taxes
sections.observation: Promotional credit does not offset the listed transaction taxes.

sections.excerpt: expiration date indicated when you receive the applicable Promotional Credit or Discount code
sections.observation: Expiration is tied to the specific issued offer terms, not a universal date.

scope: Today's reread confirms the public rules in the earlier September 24 guide. It does not establish that no account-specific or privately issued promotion exists. No code was entered, account created, or checkout tested.
